retrieval_evidence.method: targeted direct HTTPS GET/HEAD against official Canonical hosts (no web search); gpg 2.4.9 local verification
retrieval_evidence.directory_listing: https://cloud-images.ubuntu.com/releases/noble/ lists release-20261017/ as the immutable dated release entry; /release/ is the moving symlink and is NOT used as a pin
retrieval_evidence.gpg_verify: gpg --verify SHA256SUMS.gpg SHA256SUMS -> Good signature from UEC Image Automatic Signing Key <cdimage@ubuntu.com>; primary key fingerprint D2EB 4462 6FDD C30B 513D 5BB7 1A5D 6C4C 7DB8 7C81; exit 0
retrieval_evidence.image_head: HEAD each image_url -> HTTP 200; amd64 content-length 227213232, arm64 content-length 216215656; full tarball bytes were NOT downloaded
retrieval_evidence.checksum_lines: expected_sha256 values were read from the GPG-signed SHA256SUMS for ubuntu-24.04-server-cloudimg-{amd64,arm64}-root.tar.xz and the two -lxd.tar.xz metadata files

verification_rule: In artifact mode, refuse any image whose digest_status is not 'verified', whose expected_sha256 is a placeholder/repeated-character/all-zero value, whose URL is not an immutable dated primary-source URL, or whose signed-checksum/signature/key evidence is missing. A real build must fetch checksum_url, verify its GPG signature against signing_key_fingerprint, and require the downloaded root tarball SHA256 to equal expected_sha256. No silent fallback to the moving /release/ symlink, a daily image, a host image or a fixture.
fixture_rule: Offline tests use config/provenance.fixture.json explicitly. Fixture digests are synthetic and must never be used for artifact claims.
